purpose: Bounded representative engineering capacity measurement; optimizer work is development cost, not a research training result.
work_comparison: Two full cohorts per size: 2048 has twice the rollout slots, initialization work and requested jobs. Actual active samples, optimizer steps, wall time and export bytes are measured; no equal-sample or learning-quality comparison is claimed.
initialization: Fresh policy and Adam in each process; no existing checkpoint loaded and benchmark checkpoints never become research initializers.
task_contract: Inherited frozen protocol_v4 physics, reward, observation, architecture and unclipped PPO. All failed and absorbing slots remain charged. Raw 20 N abort, physical held gravity, 30 s deadline and 0.5 s dwell unchanged.
diagnostic_export: Full cases, initial validity, complete-job outcomes, terminal/control counts, model and optimizer per cohort; 450-step tensor traces for the first encountered case in each fault bin, matching the substantive training path.
scheduling_measurement: Record wall time and allocated transitions after all jobs have terminated. No early exit, partial-slot reset or asynchronous reuse is enabled in this benchmark.
stop_rule: Run 2048 only after 1024 completes with valid artifacts and measured headroom. Stop on invalid initialization, nonfinite optimizer/state, wall/resource failure or cost mismatch; retain all partial artifacts and cost bounds.
scope_and_limitations: Known timestep-sensitive physics remains unresolved; resource profiling does not pass a scientific gate or authorize a training campaign.
Two cohorts characterize early fresh-policy training, not mature-policy utilization or sustained multi-hour stability.
The same seed and sampler do not imply paired trajectories across environment counts.
No performance, recovery, equal-cost curriculum, hardware or final-test claim.
